create_lightfield_dataset: create a LightfieldDataset instance with a config object to load lightfield data for training or rendering
prepare_train_data_lightfield: prepare training data by iterating over lightfield sub-aperture images and collecting ray coordinates and RGB values
prepare_render_data_spiral: prepare render data by generating spiral camera poses or supersampled horizontal views for novel view synthesis
get_coords_lightfield: get ray coordinates for a given spatial index pair using st_scale and uv_scale parameters
create_epi_dataset: create an EPIDataset instance with a config object to load epipolar lightfield data for training or rendering
